verdict.rationale: Vue's own site lists Pinia under "Official Libraries" next to Vue Router, so the state management library is first-party. Multiple community reports independently praise Vue for shipping an official store (Vuex, its predecessor) that is maintained alongside the framework. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Pinia's features and its maintenance relationship with core (the evidence is only navigation labels), and hands-on corroboration specific to Pinia rather than Vuex.
